messages.message: I want to build a raised garden bed this weekend. It should be four feet by eight feet.
Nice. For a 4 by 8 bed, cedar boards about 12 inches tall work well. You'd need roughly 32 cubic feet of soil.
Okay. I'll plant tomatoes and basil. Remind me to buy cedar boards and soil on Saturday.
Got it: cedar boards and soil on Saturday, tomatoes and basil for planting.
Also the bed goes on the south side of the yard for sun.
South side it is, that gives the tomatoes the most sun.
